narrative:
Cost of care is planned at EUR 984M for FY2027 — 77.5% of revenue — from four drivers: the clinical, nursing and therapy workforce (66%), medical supplies, pharma and catering (16%), facility, energy and third-party services (13%), and patient transport and other care costs (5%).

The tariff wage round (TVöD / AVR, about +5%) is the largest single driver: personnel cost per care day rises faster than the daily rates in Acute and Care, where rates are capped. Energy costs ease in the modernised clinics, while medical materials inflation offsets part of the saving.

Agency nursing and therapy above the 5% target add a premium of about 1.6× per hour — converting agency hours to permanent roles is the main controllable lever.

signals.title: Daily rates vs tariff wages
signals.excerpt: DRV +4.5%, GKV +3.8%, AT index +3.0% against a tariff wage round of about +5% (planning assumption).
